summary.text: Danny Lopez is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 39, assumed office on November 6, 2024, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Lindsay Gramlich (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Lopez as Daniel Lopez; he graduated from Belen Jesuit Preparatory School, earned a bachelor's degree from Florida International University and a graduate degree from Georgia State University.

His career experience includes serving as vice president for External Affairs and Corporate Communications at Pacers Sports & Entertainment and as chief of staff and senior vice president at Strada Education Network, and holding several senior positions in the administrations of Governors Eric Holcomb (R), Mike Pence (R), and Mitch Daniels (R).
Lopez succeeded Gerald Torr (R) in District 39.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Judiciary and Ways and Means committees.
